description: Identify the geographical extent and key territories of the Chola dynasty during its peak
Analyze the administrative and military structures of the Chola dynasty, including their system of governance and notable leaders
Examine the cultural and artistic achievements of the Chola dynasty, including their contributions to temple architecture, sculpture, and literature
Investigate the economic systems and trade networks of the Chola dynasty, including their maritime trade and agricultural practices
Assess the decline and legacy of the Chola dynasty, including its impact on subsequent Indian kingdoms and empires
